boards.lab_note: the coordinating session's pilot of 2026-11-13, imported (seed 0, no API seed)

about.en: The package's own prompt (agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT): 3 headlines per stock, a decision every 5 trading days, the reply held to a strict JSON schema.
about.zh: 包里自带的 prompt（agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT）：每只股票 3 条新闻，每 5 个交易日决策一次，回复受严格 JSON schema 约束。

about.en: Four risk rules: at most 25% per stock, at least 30% cash when the regime is UNCERTAIN or RISK_OFF, sell 8% below the purchase price, prefer stocks above their 200-day average.
about.zh: 四条风险规则：单只不超过 25%，UNCERTAIN 或 RISK_OFF 时至少留 30% 现金，跌破买入价 8% 卖出，优先买在 200 日均线之上的股票。

about.en: A decision rule: buy only when the trend and the news are both positive, sell when the trend breaks or confirmed bad news arrives, otherwise hold; the judgement goes in each reason.
about.zh: 一条决策规则：趋势和新闻都向好才买，趋势破位或有已确认的坏消息就卖，否则持有，判断写进每笔订单的 reason。

method.en: Each variant changes one factor of the baseline prompt. Paired differences (same model, period and seed), mean over periods, 95% bootstrap interval, exact sign-flip p-value, Holm correction across the variants; 'noise' means the difference cannot be told apart from running the same prompt again. The attribution splits a return difference into holding more or less stock (level, timing) and holding other stocks (selection), in sums of daily returns.
method.zh: 每个变体只改基线 prompt 的一个因素。配对差（同一模型、同一时段、同一种子），按时段平均，95% bootstrap 区间，精确符号翻转检验，按变体个数做 Holm 校正；「noise」表示这个差别和把同一个 prompt 再跑一遍分不开。归因把收益差拆成持股多少（水平、择时）和持哪些股票（选股），按每日收益相加计算。

notes.en: Pilot, one seed. llama3.2 on a university LLM gateway is left out: the gateway cuts long prompts for that model, so it may not have seen the whole observation.
notes.zh: 这是 pilot，只有一个种子。学校 LLM 网关上的 llama3.2 没有算进来：网关会截断这个模型的长 prompt，它可能没看到完整的观察。
